advisories: /v1/health reports migrations_applied=0. trappoint.schema_migration is empty on this database — the appliers do not record into it — so this number contradicts the 271-file chain the submission describes. The schema fingerprint above is the trustworthy identifier; this counter is not.
note: NO CLOUDFRONT URL EXISTS. Terraform has never been applied (infra/envs/demo holds no state; no *.cloudfront.net hostname appears anywhere outside a placeholder). This run targets a local shim serving the REAL, UNMODIFIED demo-api Lambda handler and the REAL console dist over http, against a scratch database carrying the full 271-file chain and w2's demo seed. It is the truthful state of the deployment path on 2026-08-10 and it is RED. Three blockers, all outside this worker's files: (1) POST /v1/demo/gate-run is not routed in app.py so it 404s - w4 documents this as a known gap, w3 owns the route table; (2) scenario.resolve() unpacks its row as an 8-tuple while db.connection() sets row_factory=dict_row, so through the app's own connection the endpoint raises InvalidTextRepresentation on the string 'check_id'; (3) scenario.py defaults permit_id to 077a6fdd-2167-559c-b2ff-8e3c8352504d while seed_demo.py seeds dec0de00-0006-4000-8000-000000000001 on both the scratch database AND the live Cloud database, so the API cannot find its own subject without MAINLINE_DEMO_PERMIT_ID. See corroborating_run: with those three worked around, this same prover returned PROVEN on all four beats, twice, persisted=false. The acceptance gate is correct; the deployment is not ready.

Same prover, same real handler and console dist, same scratch database, with the three blockers named in the primary run worked around at the harness: the missing route supplied by calling handle_transition('demo_gate_run',...) exactly as w4 documents it is reachable today; a tuple-row psycopg connection in place of db.connection()'s dict_row; and MAINLINE_DEMO_PERMIT_ID set to the permit w2 actually seeded.
